description:
The 6th Regular meeting was a club assembly. AG Dr.Avinash Sonawane, as a mentor of the club, heard about the progress and programs and projects conducted by our club. He also provided valuable guidance for future endeavours. All directors made their impressive presentations. PP Rtn.Bhaskar Joshi Director - Community Service, Medical, joined through a Zoom call. In the beginning a very scintillating audio visual of the quarterly performace of the club was presented that captivated the audience.
Proudly announcing the Inauguration of our Official YouTube Channel with the launch of our 1st Quarter Projects & Fellowship Short Film, beautifully created by PP Rtn. Bhaskar Joshi.
The channel was inaugurated on 21st October 2026 during our 2nd Club Assembly, where AG Rtn. Dr. Avinash Sonawane appreciated this
It was conducted at Thakur Ramnarayan College where a special airconditioned auditorium with modern AV facilities was provided to our club as a good gesture by the college authorities.
